tools.name: purge_expired_lot_stock
tools.description: Deletes all inventory records for lots in a warehouse whose expiry date has passed and reduces the on-hand totals of the affected SKUs accordingly.

params.name: warehouse_id
params.description: Warehouse whose expired lots should be removed

params.name: as_of
params.description: ISO date used as the cutoff; defaults to today

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import date
from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "warehouse.db"


def _decrement_totals(conn, rows):
    for sku, qty in rows:
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE sku_totals SET on_hand = MAX(on_hand - ?, 0) WHERE sku = ?",
            (qty, sku),
        )


@tool
def purge_expired_lot_stock(warehouse_id: str, as_of: str = None) -> str:
    cutoff = as_of or date.today().isoformat()
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        rows = conn.execute(
            "SELECT sku, SUM(quantity) FROM lots "
            "WHERE warehouse_id = ? AND expiry_date < ? GROUP BY sku",
            (warehouse_id, cutoff),
        ).fetchall()
        if not rows:
            return "No expired lots found."
        _decrement_totals(conn, rows)
        cur = conn.execute(
            "DELETE FROM lots WHERE warehouse_id = ? AND expiry_date < ?",
            (warehouse_id, cutoff),
        )
        conn.commit()
        return f"Deleted {cur.rowcount} expired lots across {len(rows)} SKUs."
    finally:
        conn.close()

tools.name: transfer_stock_to_bin
tools.description: Moves a quantity of a SKU from one storage bin to another bin within the warehouse.
tools.code:
import sqlite3
from langchain_core.tools import tool


@tool
def transfer_stock_to_bin(sku: str, from_bin: str, to_bin: str, quantity: int) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect("warehouse.db")
    result = {"sku": sku, "from_bin": from_bin, "to_bin": to_bin, "moved": 0}
    with conn:
        cur = conn.execute(
            "UPDATE bin_stock SET quantity = quantity - ? "
            "WHERE bin = ? AND sku = ? AND quantity >= ?",
            (quantity, from_bin, sku, quantity),
        )
        if cur.rowcount == 0:
            result["error"] = "insufficient stock in source bin"
            return result
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO bin_stock (bin, sku, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?) "
            "ON CONFLICT(bin, sku) DO UPDATE SET quantity = quantity + excluded.quantity",
            (to_bin, sku, quantity),
        )
    result["moved"] = quantity
    return result

tools.name: delete_discontinued_sku_records
tools.description: Deletes discontinued SKUs along with their bin stock, lot, and reorder rule records. SKUs that still have units on hand are skipped unless forced.

params.name: skus
params.description: List of SKU codes to delete

params.name: force
params.description: Delete even if units remain on hand
